name: Pūrṇa
sub: three ways to hold the infinite
description: The Upaniṣadic whole, the Jaina ladder of enumerable, innumerable and infinite, and Bhāskara II's khahara.
aria: An endless spiral zoom into a mandala that contains itself
intro: Long before set theory, Indian thinkers argued about the infinite: a whole that stays whole when you remove the whole, numbers too large to count, and what you get when you divide by zero.
